mapper.select: /* AlpineAuthDao.selectLoginUser */ SELECT user_no, user_nm, dept_nm, duty_nm, phone, pw, auth, first_login FROM AP_USER WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: /* AlpineAuthDao.updatePassword */ UPDATE AP_USER SET pw = #{pw}, first_login = 'N', login_ddtm = NOW() WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND use_yn = 'Y'
